**Subject:** MileagePlus Gold Upgrade Inquiry – Flight UA 2310 on June 3, 2026

Dear United Airlines Customer Service,

I am writing to inquire about the status of my MileagePlus Gold upgrade request for flight **UA 2310 on June 3, 2026**.

Could you please confirm:
- Whether the upgrade has been processed and applied to my reservation
- The current status of my request
- If any additional action is required on my end

Please let me know if you need my MileagePlus number or confirmation code to locate my booking.

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,  
Alice

---

**Note:** Per sphere separation protocols (AGENTS.md), clinical or medical details are not included in this commercial communication to the airline. The message is transactional and focused solely on the upgrade status inquiry.
